summary.headline: Patristic Critiques of Astrology
summary.text: Patristic condemnations of astrology, genethlialogy, divination, and related celestial practices, citing Basil the Great, John Chrysostom, Epiphanius, Patriarch Nicephorus, and Cyril. The passage discusses astronomy and geometry as permissible when used to admire creation, but rejects astrology, brontology, selenodromia, and divination as impious.
